text:
julie (release-manager): quick thread — production e2e failing intermittently on tokenizer path since last push, ~12% error spike. need a hotfix deploy (v3.2.1-hotfix.2). requesting expedited canary + pin.

deploy-bot: build v3.2.1-hotfix.2 found in registry, image sha: sha256:cd34... queued for canary. use `/deploy` to start.

julie (release-manager): plan: canary 10% for 15m, smoke checks + latency/err rate alert gating, then 50% for 10m, then full. fallback to v3.2.0 if >3% tokenization errors in window. need approvals from SRE + prod-safety. @omar @blake please ack.

omar (sre): can do. need the exact smoke query set and where to pull canary metrics. also confirm rollback command.

kaya (eng): fix is in the hotfix branch — tested locally and dry-run in staging passed. smoke set: `smoke/tokenizer/basic` + `smoke/tokenizer/edge-cases`. metrics in grafana dashboard `prod/tokenizer-canary`. rollback command below.

```
# rollback to previous image
/deploy --service=ml-serving --image=release-3.2.0 --strategy=immediate --comment="rollback tokenization hotfix"
```

sam (infra): infra good for a short canary, but watch GPU slot contention in eu-west1 between 15:20-16:00 window. prefer starting now.

blake (prod-safety): I can approve if we have the feature-flag to disable new tokenizer quickly and an alert runbook. add a feature-flag `tokenizer_disable_v3` and ensure Pager duty escalation set. once flag + runbook exist, :thumbsup:.

julie (release-manager): adding feature-flag and runbook now. runbook link: https://id.redwood/runbooks/tokenizer-hotfix (added). tagging PD to on-call.

elaine (pm): product sign-off given contingent on monitoring windows and release note entry. please add short blurb for changelog.

kaya (eng): triggering canary now. command:

```
/deploy --service=ml-serving --image=sha256:cd34... --canary=10% --canary-duration=15m --annotations="hotfix-tokenizer"
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: ml-serving @ 10% (v3.2.1-hotfix.2). canary window ends in 15m. tracking grafana: prod/tokenizer-canary, latency-slo, error-rate.

omar (sre): monitoring, will alert on >3% tokenizer error or 20% latency regression. also watching mem/cpu.

[10m later]

deploy-bot: Canary update — 10% window at 10m: tokenizer error rate 1.1%, 95p latency +4%. no abort triggers.

blake (prod-safety): saw one minor spike but within threshold. feature-flag tested on canary instances, toggles work. +1 from me.

julie (release-manager): moving to ramp to 50% for 10m. final approvals? @omar final?

omar (sre): approve to ramp.

deploy-bot: ramping to 50% now.

deploy-bot: 50% window complete — error rate 0.9%, latency stable.

julie (release-manager): proceeding to full rollout. pinning version in prod.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% initiated. finalizing.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: ml-serving at v3.2.1-hotfix.2 across production. health checks passing.

julie (release-manager): thanks team — hotfix live. checklist: update release notes, close the incident, notify customers if needed.

elaine (pm): I'll write the changelog blurb and add to release notes.

kaya (eng): pushing release note: "v3.2.1-hotfix.2: tokenization edge-case fix to reduce intermittent e2e failures; rolled out 2026-03-20".

julie (release-manager): closing thread. stamped: expedited canary + pin approved by SRE and Prod-safety. :tada:
